entities.summary: Daniel Elahi Galán Riveros is a Colombian professional tennis player. He reached a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 56 on 17 July 2023. He also has a career-high doubles ranking of No. 305 achieved on 26 February 2018. He is currently the No. 2 Colombian player. His best result at a Grand Slam is a fourth-round appearance at the 2023 Wimbledon Championships.
